name: Sakai
description_en:
Sakai is a community-developed open-source learning-management system for organizing courses, assignments, assessment and collaboration. Institutions can configure it themselves or work with commercial hosting/support affiliates.

A hosted sample account is an evaluation environment. It should not be confused with a permanent production hosting entitlement or with the operational work of running a self-hosted LMS.
description_zh:
Sakai 是社区开发的开源学习管理系统，用于课程、作业、考核及协作。机构可自行配置，或采用商业托管和支持伙伴。

托管样例账户是评估环境，不能等同于永久生产托管权益，也不能替代自托管所需运维。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine content, assignments, quizzes and rubric-based feedback.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合内容、作业、测验和量规反馈。

core_features.explanation_en: Configurable roles, LTI and APIs support institution-specific workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可配置角色、LTI 和 API 支持机构流程。

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The official feature page describes lessons combining resources, quizzes, assignments and media, with conditional access. It lists rubric-based grading, submission feedback, group collaboration, configurable roles and permissions, LTI and APIs. Community-contributed tools can extend the packaged system, but their availability and maintenance must be checked individually.
sections.zh: 官方功能页介绍把资源、测验、作业及媒体组织为课程，并支持条件访问，另有量规评分、提交反馈、小组协作、可配置角色权限、LTI 和 API。社区工具可扩展发行包，但可用性及维护需要逐个检查。

sections.en: Create a seminar site, add a lesson and group assignment, and verify that each group sees the correct material. Submit as a learner, grade with the intended rubric and inspect feedback from the learner side. Also check a late or incomplete submission and an instructor role change. This is a suggested institutional pilot, not a Sakai deployment executed for this profile.
sections.zh: 建立研讨课站点，添加课程和分组作业，验证每组看到正确材料。以学员身份提交，用预期量规评分，再从学员端检查反馈。还应检查迟交、未完成及教师角色变更。本例是机构试点建议，本文未部署 Sakai。

sections.title_en: Free download and hosted sample are different
sections.title_zh: 免费下载与托管样例不同
sections.en: The official Try page offers a free download to configure yourself and a cloud sample courtesy of Longsight, where users can try instructor and student roles. It publishes no production managed-hosting rate or SLA. Source availability does not eliminate infrastructure, upgrades, backup and support costs. Seek a separate hosting proposal if the institution will not operate the service.
sections.zh: 官方 Try 页提供自行配置的免费下载，以及 Longsight 提供的云样例，可体验教师和学员角色；没有生产托管费率或 SLA。源码可得不会消除基础设施、升级、备份及支持成本。机构不自行运维时，需另询托管方案。

sections.title_zh: 机构负责人及版本核对
sections.en: Start with a sample course and a documented list of roles, integrations and record-retention requirements. The feature page includes older release videos, so do not infer that every demonstrated UI matches the chosen current distribution. Sakai fits organizations able to operate or procure an education-focused platform. Exact distribution license text, supported server requirements, upgrade paths and restoration were not verified here.
sections.zh: 先准备样例课程及角色、集成和记录保留要求。功能页包含旧版本视频，不能假定所有演示 UI 都与所选发行版一致。它适合能够运维或采购教育平台的机构。具体发行包许可文本、受支持服务器要求、升级路径和恢复未核实。
